description: This file defines classes and interfaces for a mobility manager component in a 5G network system, including measurement handling, metrics reporting, and handover management.

classes.name: mobility_manager_measurement_handler
classes.description: Interface for handling measurement-related events, such as neighbor cell quality improvements.

classes.name: mobility_manager_metrics_handler
classes.description: Interface for capturing and reporting mobility management metrics.

classes.name: mobility_manager
classes.description: Implements mobility management functionalities including handover triggers, measurement handling, and metrics reporting.

methods.name: mobility_manager(const mobility_manager_cfg&, mobility_manager_cu_cp_notifier&, ngap_repository&, du_processor_repository&, ue_manager&)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the mobility manager with configuration, notifier, database references, and UE manager.

methods.name: trigger_handover
methods.description: Initiates a handover from source to target PCI.

methods.name: trigger_conditional_handover
methods.description: Initiates a conditional handover with a timeout and optional override time.

methods.name: handle_neighbor_better_than_spcell
methods.description: Handles event when a neighbor cell is better than the serving cell for a UE.

methods.name: handle_handover
methods.description: Performs the handover process for a UE.

methods.name: handle_inter_cu_handover
methods.description: Handles handover between different CU-CP units.

methods.name: handle_intra_cu_handover
methods.description: Handles handover within the same CU-CP.

methods.name: handle_conditional_handover
methods.description: Handles the logic for conditional handover based on target cells and timeout.

methods.name: get_metrics_handler
methods.description: Returns the metrics aggregator for reporting.

methods.name: handle_mobility_metrics_report_request
methods.description: Returns current mobility management metrics report.
